quote.summary: NASN Intelligent Tech (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd. is a China-based company principally engaged in providing mission-critical brake-by-wire solutions for intelligent driving. The Company's solutions integrate proprietary full-stack control algorithms, software and hardware. Its solutions include NASN brake system (NBS) solution, electronic stability control (ESC) solution, and NASN brake control (NBC) solution. The NBS solution is an electronic brake booster system, primarily applied in entry-level new energy vehicles, providing a cost-efficient and reliable brake solution suited for such vehicle models. The ESC solution provides electronic stability and safety control. The NBC solution is a highly integrated braking control system that combines braking, stability control and energy-recovery functions within a single unit and is dedicated solely to new energy vehicles equipped with intelligent driving functions.
